{{Short description|Uniform tiling of the hyperbolic plane}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U54_01}}
In [[geometry]], the '''truncated order-4 pentagonal tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>0,1</sub>{5,4}.

== Uniform colorings ==
A half symmetry [1+,4,5] = [5,5] coloring can be constructed with two colors of decagons. This coloring is called a ''truncated pentapentagonal tiling''.
:[[File:Uniform tiling 552-t012.png|240px]]

== Symmetry ==
There is only one subgroup of [5,5], [5,5]<sup>+</sup>, removing all the mirrors. This symmetry can be doubled to [[542 symmetry]] by adding a bisecting mirror.
